senses.en: money paid to use a road or bridge

senses.zh: số thương vong; thiệt hại nặng nề
senses.en: the number harmed, or damage caused by something
to ring a large bell slowly and repeatedly

ex.en: We paid a toll before driving across the bridge.
Long working hours can take a heavy toll on employees' physical health and family relationships.

col: pay a toll｜trả phí cầu đường
take a toll on｜gây tổn hại cho
a bell tolls｜tiếng chuông ngân chậm
tip: take a toll on nghĩa là gây tổn hại; death toll là số người chết.

senses.zh: thuộc tình dục; liên quan đến giới tính
senses.en: Relating to sex or physical attraction between people.
Involving reproduction through the joining of male and female cells.

ex.en: The clinic offers confidential advice about sexual health.
Schools can provide age-appropriate sexual health education to help young people make informed decisions.

col: sexual attraction｜sự hấp dẫn tình dục
tip: sexual nghĩa là liên quan đến tình dục; sexy mới thường mang nghĩa quyến rũ.

senses.en: the act of taking part in an activity or event

ex.en: Your participation made our neighbourhood clean-up much more enjoyable.
Active participation in community projects can strengthen social connections and give residents a greater sense of belonging.

col: public participation｜sự tham gia của công chúng
tip: Thường không đếm được; tham gia hoạt động nào dùng participation in.

senses.zh: làm say mê; thu hút sâu sắc
senses.en: to attract and hold someone's attention very strongly

ex.en: The colourful fish fascinated the children at the aquarium.
Ancient civilisations continue to fascinate researchers because their achievements reveal remarkable solutions to complex practical problems.

col: fascinate an audience｜thu hút khán giả
be fascinated by｜bị say mê bởi
never cease to fascinate｜luôn khiến người ta say mê
tip: Điều gây say mê dùng fascinating; người cảm thấy say mê dùng fascinated.

senses.en: a real or imaginary line around which something turns
a reference line used to locate points on a graph

ex.en: The globe spins smoothly around its tilted axis.
The horizontal axis represents time, while the vertical axis shows changes in average household energy consumption.

col: rotate on its axis｜quay quanh trục của nó
tip: Số nhiều là axes /ˈæksiːz/, cần phân biệt với số nhiều của axe.

senses.en: numerical facts collected and organised to describe something

senses.zh: môn thống kê; thống kê học
senses.en: the study of collecting, analysing, and interpreting numerical data

ex.en: These statistics show how much water our household uses.
Official statistics indicate that access to higher education has improved significantly in rural areas.

col: official statistics｜số liệu thống kê chính thức
compile statistics｜tổng hợp số liệu thống kê
statistics show that｜số liệu thống kê cho thấy
tip: Chỉ số liệu thì động từ chia số nhiều; chỉ môn thống kê thì động từ chia số ít.

senses.zh: sự lưu trữ; sự cất giữ
senses.en: The act of keeping things somewhere until they are needed.

senses.zh: lưu trữ dữ liệu; dung lượng lưu trữ
senses.en: The capacity or process of keeping digital information for future use.

ex.en: These boxes provide useful storage for all my winter clothes.
Improved energy storage could make renewable electricity more reliable when sunlight and wind are unavailable.

tip: storage thường không đếm được; một phòng kho cụ thể dùng a storeroom.

senses.en: a word that connects words, phrases, or clauses

senses.zh: sự kết hợp; sự đồng thời xảy ra
senses.en: a combination of things or events occurring together

ex.en: Our teacher used coloured cards to explain conjunctions.
Public transport improvements work best in conjunction with policies that discourage unnecessary car journeys.

col: in conjunction with｜kết hợp với; cùng với
tip: in conjunction with thường nghĩa là cùng với hoặc kết hợp với.

senses.en: to focus your mind calmly, often as a mental exercise
to think deeply and carefully about something

ex.en: I meditate for ten minutes before breakfast each morning.
Some employers encourage staff to meditate during breaks as a way of managing workplace stress.

col: meditate on something｜suy ngẫm sâu về điều gì
tip: Suy ngẫm sâu về điều gì thường dùng meditate on hoặc upon.

senses.en: Worried or nervous about something uncertain.
Very eager to do something or for something to happen.

ex.en: I felt anxious while waiting for my exam results.
Students may become anxious about their future when career guidance is unavailable at school.

col: anxious to please｜nóng lòng làm vừa lòng
tip: anxious about diễn tả lo lắng; anxious to do thường diễn tả sự nóng lòng.

senses.zh: biện minh; chứng minh là hợp lý
senses.en: Give good reasons for an action, decision, or belief.

ex.en: I cannot justify buying another coat this winter.
Governments must justify major infrastructure spending by demonstrating clear benefits for the wider community.

col: justify a decision｜biện minh cho một quyết định
justify the cost｜chứng minh chi phí là hợp lý
justify doing something｜biện minh cho việc làm gì
tip: Sau justify đi danh từ hoặc danh động từ, không đi với động từ nguyên mẫu có to.

senses.en: A pleasant smell, especially from flowers or perfume.
A liquid or substance used to give a pleasant smell.

ex.en: The fragrance of fresh roses filled the small kitchen.
Some consumers prefer products without added fragrance because scented ingredients can irritate sensitive skin.

tip: fragrance thường chỉ mùi dễ chịu; smell có thể thơm hoặc hôi.

senses.en: someone with exceptional intelligence or creative ability

senses.zh: tài năng thiên bẩm; năng khiếu phi thường
senses.en: exceptional natural ability in a particular area

ex.en: My sister is a genius at fixing broken toys.
Creative genius often develops when schools allow students to experiment rather than simply memorise facts.

col: a mathematical genius｜một thiên tài toán học
a genius at｜người rất giỏi về
a stroke of genius｜một ý tưởng thiên tài
tip: Chỉ người thiên tài thì đếm được; chỉ tài năng phi thường thì thường không đếm được.

senses.zh: thư mục tham khảo; danh mục tài liệu
senses.en: a list of sources used or relevant to a subject

ex.en: I added the missing book to my essay's bibliography.
A carefully prepared bibliography allows readers to locate sources and examine the evidence supporting an academic argument.

col: compile a bibliography｜lập thư mục tham khảo
annotated bibliography｜thư mục có chú giải
tip: bibliography là danh sách tài liệu; biography là tiểu sử.

senses.en: Receive money or property from someone who has died
Receive physical characteristics genetically from your parents
Receive responsibilities or problems left by a previous person

ex.en: Leila inherited a small cottage from her grandmother.
Future generations may inherit serious environmental problems unless governments take decisive action to reduce pollution.

col: inherit a fortune｜thừa kế một khối tài sản lớn
inherit traits｜thừa hưởng các đặc điểm di truyền
tip: Hay dùng inherit sth from sb; cũng dùng cho đặc điểm di truyền.

senses.en: A small rodent with a bushy tail, often living in trees.
To store something secretly for later use, usually with away.

ex.en: A squirrel buried a nut beside our garden gate.
Urban parks provide squirrels with food and shelter, although feeding them can alter their natural behaviour.

col: squirrel away money｜lén tích cóp tiền
tip: Khi là động từ thường dùng squirrel away, nghĩa là lặng lẽ cất trữ.

senses.en: A light, silver-coloured metal used in cans and aircraft.

ex.en: This aluminium pan is light enough to carry camping.
Recycling aluminium requires significantly less energy than producing new metal from raw materials, reducing industrial emissions.

tip: Anh–Mỹ thường viết aluminum, đọc /əˈluːmɪnəm/.

senses.en: Someone who secretly gathers information about a country or organisation

senses.zh: làm gián điệp; theo dõi lén
senses.en: To secretly watch someone or gather information about them
To notice someone or something, especially after looking carefully

ex.en: I spied a tiny kitten hiding behind the flowerpot.
Many users worry that connected devices could spy on their activities without permission.

col: spy on someone｜theo dõi ai một cách lén lút
tip: Theo dõi ai dùng spy on; quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ là spied.

senses.zh: hệ thống chiếu sáng; hiệu ứng ánh sáng
senses.en: The lights in a place or the effects they produce.

ex.en: The soft lighting makes this room feel warm and cosy.
Improved street lighting can make pedestrians feel safer and encourage more people to walk after dark.

tip: Khi nói chiếu sáng nói chung thì không đếm được; một bóng đèn dùng a light.

senses.en: someone held captive to force others to meet demands

ex.en: The hostage returned home safely and hugged her family.
Governments must balance public safety with the need to secure the release of every hostage.

col: take someone hostage｜bắt ai làm con tin
hold someone hostage｜giữ ai làm con tin
hostage negotiations｜đàm phán giải cứu con tin
tip: Trong take hoặc hold someone hostage, hostage không có mạo từ phía trước.

senses.zh: chồng lên nhau một phần; trùng lặp
senses.en: Covering part of the same area or period.
Sharing some features, interests, or responsibilities.

ex.en: The roof was covered with rows of overlapping tiles.
Overlapping responsibilities between government departments can create confusion and delay the implementation of essential public services.

col: overlapping circles｜các hình tròn giao nhau
tip: Nhấn mạnh sự trùng một phần, không nhất thiết hoàn toàn giống nhau; cũng dùng cho thời gian trùng nhau.

senses.en: Different from what is usual or expected, often causing concern.

ex.en: The mechanic noticed an abnormal noise from the engine.
Regular medical screening can detect abnormal changes before they develop into conditions that require complex treatment.

col: abnormal heart rhythm｜nhịp tim bất thường
tip: Thường dùng trong y học hoặc hiện tượng bất thường, không nên tuỳ tiện dùng để đánh giá con người.

senses.zh: nâng cao; tăng cường; cải thiện
senses.en: Improve the quality, value, or appeal of something

ex.en: A little lemon juice enhances the flavour of this soup.
Access to green spaces can enhance residents' wellbeing and encourage more active lifestyles in crowded cities.

col: enhance the quality of｜cải thiện chất lượng của
enhance someone's reputation｜nâng cao danh tiếng của ai
tip: Nhấn mạnh việc tăng chất lượng, hiệu quả hay giá trị, không chỉ tăng số lượng.

senses.en: Musical instruments played by hitting, shaking, or scraping them.

ex.en: My sister plays percussion in the school band.
Group percussion lessons can help children develop coordination while encouraging cooperation and creative expression.

tip: Chỉ chung thì không đếm được; một nhạc cụ gõ cụ thể dùng a percussion instrument.

senses.en: To give someone money or something else for loss or harm.
To balance a disadvantage by providing something beneficial.

ex.en: The airline compensated us for our lost luggage.
Governments should compensate farmers for income lost when agricultural land is converted into protected habitats.

col: compensate someone for a loss｜bồi thường tổn thất cho ai
compensate for a lack of｜bù đắp sự thiếu hụt
tip: Bồi thường ai dùng compensate sb for sth; bù đắp dùng compensate for.

senses.en: To do something illegal or seriously wrong.
To promise firmly to do something or support someone.
To make money, time, or resources available for a purpose.

ex.en: The police arrested someone who had committed a burglary.
Governments must commit sufficient resources to public transport if they want to reduce urban traffic congestion.

col: commit to doing something｜cam kết làm việc gì
commit resources to｜dành nguồn lực cho
tip: Trong commit to, to là giới từ nên theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ.

senses.en: To give time, effort, or resources to someone or something.

ex.en: I devote an hour each evening to practising the piano.
Governments should devote more resources to preventive healthcare rather than relying entirely on expensive medical treatments.

col: devote time to｜dành thời gian cho
devote resources to｜dành nguồn lực cho
tip: Trong devote…to, to là giới từ nên theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ.

senses.zh: bản thân; con người thật của mình
senses.en: The personality and qualities that make you who you are.

ex.en: After a good sleep, I felt like my usual self.
Creative activities can help young people develop a stronger sense of self during periods of rapid change.

col: a sense of self｜ý thức về bản thân
your true self｜con người thật của bạn
your usual self｜con người thường ngày của bạn
tip: self là danh từ; để nói “bản thân tôi” thường dùng myself.

senses.en: Relating to teeth or their care and treatment

ex.en: My dental appointment is early tomorrow, before work.
Providing affordable dental care in schools could reduce health inequalities and prevent problems later in life.

tip: dental là tính từ; nha sĩ là dentist.

senses.en: to hit someone or something with a closed hand
a hit made with a closed hand
to make a hole using a special tool

ex.en: She punched the training bag, then caught her breath.
Boxers learn to deliver a controlled punch while maintaining balance and protecting themselves from injury.

col: punch a bag｜đấm vào bao cát
throw a punch｜tung một cú đấm
punch a hole｜đục một cái lỗ
tip: punch là đấm bằng nắm tay; slap thường là tát bằng lòng bàn tay.

senses.en: To eat a meal, especially dinner.

ex.en: We dined outside beside the river last night.
Tourists who dine at locally owned restaurants can support small businesses and experience regional food traditions.

col: dine with friends｜dùng bữa với bạn bè
dine at a restaurant｜dùng bữa tại nhà hàng
tip: Trang trọng hơn eat, thường không đi thẳng với món ăn làm tân ngữ.

senses.en: A tight fastening made by tying rope or string.
To tie something into a knot.
A speed unit equal to one nautical mile per hour.

ex.en: This knot is too tight for me to undo.
During outdoor education courses, students learn to tie a secure knot before attempting basic climbing activities.

col: a speed of twenty knots｜tốc độ hai mươi hải lý một giờ
tip: Chữ k không đọc; knot trong tốc độ tàu là một hải lý mỗi giờ.

senses.en: To move slowly, carried by water or air.

senses.zh: dần lệch hướng; đi lang thang vô định
senses.en: To move or change gradually without clear purpose or control.
The general meaning of what someone says or writes.

ex.en: We watched a fallen leaf drift across the pond.
Without affordable housing and stable employment, young residents may gradually drift away from rural communities.

col: drift off to sleep｜dần ngủ thiếp đi
tip: drift nhấn mạnh việc bị nước hay gió cuốn đi, hoặc thiếu phương hướng rõ ràng.

senses.zh: thích nghi; làm cho thích nghi
senses.en: to change behaviour or features to suit new conditions
to change something for a different use or audience

ex.en: Our cat quickly adapted to life in the new flat.
Schools must adapt their teaching methods to meet the needs of students from diverse cultural backgrounds.

col: adapt to change｜thích nghi với sự thay đổi
adapt teaching methods｜điều chỉnh phương pháp dạy học
adapt a novel for television｜chuyển thể tiểu thuyết thành phim truyền hình
tip: adapt to theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ; đừng nhầm với adopt (áp dụng).

senses.zh: sự cám dỗ; điều cám dỗ
senses.en: A strong desire for something, or something causing that desire.

ex.en: I resisted the temptation to eat another slice of cake.
Students may face the temptation to copy online material rather than develop their own ideas.

col: give in to temptation｜không cưỡng lại được cám dỗ
the temptation to do something｜sự cám dỗ làm việc gì
tip: Hay dùng the temptation to do, chỉ sự cám dỗ muốn làm điều gì.

senses.en: a thick roll of dried tobacco leaves made for smoking

ex.en: An unlit cigar lay inside the small wooden box.
Public health campaigns should explain that smoking cigars also carries serious risks to health.

tip: cigar là xì gà; cigarette là thuốc lá thường được cuốn bằng giấy.

senses.en: Felt or done by each person towards the other.
Shared by two or more people or groups.

ex.en: Our friendship grew through mutual trust and honest conversations.
Successful international cooperation depends on mutual respect and a willingness to address shared environmental challenges.

col: mutual benefit｜đôi bên cùng có lợi
by mutual agreement｜theo thoả thuận của hai bên
tip: mutual friend là bạn chung, không phải bạn của nhau.

senses.en: the quality of being kind and morally good

senses.zh: chất dinh dưỡng; phần bổ dưỡng
senses.en: the substances in food that help keep you healthy
used to express surprise, worry, or shock

ex.en: Her goodness showed when she shared her last sandwich.
Steaming vegetables can preserve more of their natural goodness than boiling them for long periods.

col: out of the goodness of your heart｜hoàn toàn vì lòng tốt
tip: Khi là danh từ thường không đếm được; My goodness diễn tả sự ngạc nhiên.

senses.en: A black material made by heating wood with little air.
Charcoal sticks used for drawing.

ex.en: We cooked the vegetables over glowing charcoal in the garden.
Heavy demand for charcoal can contribute to deforestation where trees are harvested faster than they can regrow.

tip: charcoal thường không đếm được; coal là than đá, không phải than củi.

senses.en: Easily broken or damaged
Easily weakened, upset, or disrupted

ex.en: Please wrap these fragile cups before packing them.
Tourism can threaten fragile ecosystems when large groups visit sensitive habitats without adequate environmental safeguards.

col: fragile ecosystem｜hệ sinh thái mong manh
fragile recovery｜sự phục hồi mong manh
tip: Vừa chỉ vật dễ vỡ, vừa chỉ kinh tế hay cảm xúc mong manh.

senses.en: One of the curved bones surrounding the chest.
A piece of meat containing an animal's rib bones.
To tease someone in a friendly way.

ex.en: The doctor pointed to a rib on the model.
Wearing appropriate protective equipment can reduce the risk of rib injuries during contact sports.

col: rib someone about something｜trêu ai về việc gì
tip: Chỉ sườn ăn thường dùng số nhiều ribs; động từ rib mang tính thân mật.

senses.en: Feeling unhappy because you lack company
Quiet and remote, with few or no people

ex.en: I felt lonesome after my sister moved away.
Older adults may feel lonesome after retirement, especially if they have few opportunities for regular social contact.

col: a lonesome road｜một con đường vắng vẻ
tip: Thường gặp trong Anh–Mỹ; lonely thông dụng hơn, còn alone chỉ có nghĩa một mình.

senses.en: A box holding a dead person's body for burial or cremation.

ex.en: White flowers lay on the closed wooden coffin.
The materials used to make a coffin can reflect local resources and cultural traditions.

col: a wooden coffin｜một chiếc quan tài gỗ
a nail in the coffin｜nhân tố đẩy đến thất bại
tip: Trong Anh–Mỹ, casket cũng thường chỉ quan tài.

senses.zh: giao dịch; việc xử lý nghiệp vụ
senses.en: an act of buying, selling, or exchanging money

ex.en: The cashier gave me a receipt for the transaction.
Secure payment systems are essential for protecting personal information during online transactions and maintaining consumer confidence.

col: complete a transaction｜hoàn tất giao dịch
tip: Thường đếm được: một giao dịch là a transaction.

senses.en: An organised list of items, often with descriptions or pictures.

senses.zh: lập danh mục; ghi chép hệ thống
senses.en: To arrange and record items in an organised list.

ex.en: I found a sturdy desk in the furniture catalog.
A searchable digital catalog allows researchers to locate historical documents without travelling to distant archives.

col: catalog a collection｜lập danh mục cho bộ sưu tập
tip: catalog là cách viết phổ biến trong Anh–Mỹ; Anh–Anh thường viết catalogue.

senses.en: Far away from towns, cities, or other people.
Done or controlled from a different location.

senses.zh: rất nhỏ; khó có khả năng
senses.en: Very unlikely to happen.

ex.en: They live in a remote village surrounded by mountains.
Remote working can expand employment opportunities for people who live far from major urban centres.

tip: remote cũng có thể là danh từ, trong khẩu ngữ chỉ cái điều khiển từ xa.

senses.en: not sensible or intelligent, in informal and often insulting use

senses.zh: chết lặng; không nói nên lời
senses.en: temporarily unable to speak because of surprise or strong emotion
unable to speak; an outdated and potentially offensive description

ex.en: It was dumb to leave my keys inside again.
Simplified news should improve accessibility without dumbing down complex issues or removing evidence that readers need.

col: a dumb mistake｜một lỗi ngớ ngẩn
struck dumb｜sững sờ không nói nên lời
dumb down｜đơn giản hoá quá mức
tip: Chữ b cuối không đọc; dùng để nói người ngu có tính xúc phạm, còn nghĩa “câm” đã lỗi thời.
note: Dùng để chỉ người ngu ngốc có thể gây xúc phạm; cách dùng chỉ người không nói được đã lỗi thời.

senses.en: To produce young, or keep animals to produce young.
A group of domestic animals sharing particular inherited characteristics.
To cause something, especially something harmful, to develop.

ex.en: These birds usually breed here during the warmer months.
Conservation programmes breed endangered animals in protected environments before releasing them into suitable natural habitats.

col: a breed of dog｜một giống chó
breed resentment｜gây ra sự oán giận
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là bred; breed (giống) khác species (loài).

senses.en: A fibre carrying signals between the brain and body.
The courage to do something difficult or frightening.

senses.zh: sự trơ trẽn; sự láo xược
senses.en: Rude confidence that makes someone behave without respect.

ex.en: The dentist explained that a nerve was causing the pain.
Damage to a single nerve can affect movement and reduce a patient's quality of life.

col: have the nerve to do something｜có gan làm việc gì
tip: nerve nghĩa là dũng khí thường không đếm được; nerves có thể chỉ trạng thái căng thẳng.

senses.zh: đề xuất; đề nghị; kế hoạch
senses.en: A suggested plan for others to consider.
An act of asking someone to marry you.

ex.en: Everyone liked my proposal to turn the spare room into an office.
The council is considering a proposal to replace an unused car park with affordable housing.

col: put forward a proposal｜đưa ra đề xuất
approve a proposal｜phê duyệt đề xuất
a proposal to do something｜đề xuất làm việc gì
tip: proposal to do nghĩa là đề xuất làm việc gì, thường là danh từ đếm được.

senses.zh: bền vững (không gây hại môi trường)
senses.en: Using resources without exhausting them or causing lasting environmental damage.

senses.zh: có thể duy trì lâu dài
senses.en: Able to continue over a long period.

ex.en: She chooses sustainable products with little or no plastic packaging.
Cities should promote sustainable transport by investing in reliable bus services and safe cycling infrastructure.

tip: renewable nhấn mạnh khả năng tái tạo; sustainable nhấn mạnh tính bền vững.

senses.zh: sự mở rộng; sự bành trướng; sự giãn nở
senses.en: An increase in size, amount, or area

ex.en: The kitchen expansion gave us room for a table.
Rapid urban expansion can threaten nearby farmland unless local authorities introduce effective planning controls.

tip: Động từ là expand; danh từ đổi thành expansion.

senses.en: Objects shaped from clay and hardened by heating.

senses.zh: nghề làm gốm; nghệ thuật gốm
senses.en: The activity of making objects from clay.
A place where clay objects are made.

ex.en: The market stall displayed pottery in soft earthy colours.
Traditional pottery can reveal how earlier societies stored food, traded goods, and expressed their cultural identity.

tip: Chỉ đồ gốm nói chung thì không đếm được; một món dùng a piece of pottery.

senses.zh: sự phụ thuộc; sự dựa vào
senses.en: the need to rely on someone or something
a strong physical or mental need for a substance

ex.en: Learning to cycle reduced my dependence on lifts from friends.
Investment in renewable energy can reduce a country's dependence on imported fuels and improve energy security.

col: financial dependence｜phụ thuộc về tài chính
tip: Cụm cố định là dependence on, không dùng dependence of.

senses.en: To speak too proudly about your achievements or possessions.
To have a feature that deserves admiration.
A statement expressing excessive pride in something about yourself.

ex.en: He always boasts about how fast he can run.
The city boasts an extensive public transport network, making it an attractive destination for sustainable tourism.

col: boast about achievements｜khoe khoang về thành tích
an empty boast｜lời khoe khoang suông
tip: Khoe về điều gì dùng boast about; nghĩa “có” thì đi thẳng với tân ngữ.

senses.en: preferring traditional ideas and avoiding major changes
deliberately low or cautious to avoid overestimating
someone who favours traditional values and limited change

ex.en: My uncle is conservative and dislikes changing family traditions.
Even conservative estimates suggest that improving home insulation could substantially reduce household energy consumption.

col: conservative approach｜cách tiếp cận thận trọng
tip: Viết thường thường nghĩa là bảo thủ; viết hoa có thể chỉ đảng Bảo thủ.

senses.zh: củ cải turnip; củ cải tròn
senses.en: a round root vegetable, usually white with a purple top

ex.en: I added a chopped turnip to the vegetable soup.
Growing root vegetables such as turnips can help communities diversify local food supplies during cooler months.

tip: Chỉ củ turnip, đừng nhầm với radish (củ cải đỏ) hay swede (củ cải Thuỵ Điển).

senses.en: Someone who directs an orchestra or choir
A material that allows heat or electricity to pass through
Someone who checks or sells tickets on public transport

ex.en: The conductor raised her arms, and the orchestra fell silent.
Copper is an effective conductor of electricity, making it a common material in household wiring.

col: an orchestra conductor｜nhạc trưởng dàn nhạc giao hưởng
a good conductor of heat｜chất dẫn nhiệt tốt
a train conductor｜nhân viên soát vé tàu
tip: Chất dẫn thường đi với of heat hoặc of electricity.

senses.en: meet someone or experience something, especially unexpectedly
an unexpected meeting or experience involving someone or something

ex.en: We encountered a curious fox on our evening walk.
Students studying abroad may encounter cultural differences that challenge their assumptions about communication and social behaviour.

col: encounter resistance｜gặp phải sự kháng cự
a chance encounter｜cuộc gặp tình cờ
an encounter with｜cuộc chạm trán với
tip: Động từ đi thẳng với tân ngữ; danh từ hay dùng an encounter with.

senses.en: A chemical substance with a pH below seven.
Containing acid or having a sharp, sour taste.
Expressing criticism in a sharp and unkind way.

ex.en: The acid in lemon juice can help remove stains.
Acid rain can damage forests and reduce the ability of lakes to support aquatic life.

col: an acid remark｜lời nhận xét cay độc
tip: acid có thể là danh từ hoặc tính từ; acidic thường chỉ tính chất có tính axit.

senses.en: a part or share of a whole

senses.zh: mối quan hệ tỷ lệ; sự cân xứng
senses.en: the relationship in size or amount between things

ex.en: A large proportion of my wages goes on rent.
The proportion of residents using public transport increased after the city introduced cheaper monthly passes.

col: a large proportion of｜một phần lớn
tip: Sau a proportion of, động từ chia số ít hay số nhiều tuỳ danh từ được nói đến.

senses.en: to draw air through the nose to smell or clear it
an act or sound of drawing air through the nose
to show that something seems unworthy of consideration

ex.en: The puppy sniffed my shoes before letting me inside.
Trained dogs can sniff out certain substances, making them valuable partners in wildlife conservation projects.

col: sniff the air｜ngửi mùi trong không khí
sniff out｜đánh hơi ra; phát hiện
tip: sniff at có thể là coi thường; sniff out nghĩa là đánh hơi hoặc tìm ra.

senses.en: with continuing loyalty or commitment
in a way that accurately matches the original

ex.en: Our dog waited faithfully beside the door every evening.
Museum restorers aim to reproduce historical colours faithfully while preserving as much original material as possible.

col: reproduce faithfully｜tái hiện đúng nguyên bản
Yours faithfully｜Trân trọng (kết thư trang trọng)
tip: Trong thư trang trọng kiểu Anh, khi không biết tên người nhận thường kết bằng Yours faithfully.

senses.en: put furniture into a room or building
provide someone with something needed, especially information

ex.en: We furnished our flat with second-hand tables and chairs.
Applicants must furnish the university with evidence of their qualifications before their applications can be assessed.

col: furnish a flat｜trang bị đồ đạc cho căn hộ
furnish someone with evidence｜cung cấp bằng chứng cho ai
tip: furnish A with B là cung cấp B cho A; nghĩa “cung cấp” khá trang trọng.

senses.zh: lời chia tay; sự từ biệt
senses.en: An act of saying goodbye, especially before a long separation.
Used to say goodbye in a formal or emotional way.
Held or given to mark someone's departure.

ex.en: We gathered at the station for a final farewell.
A farewell ceremony can help graduating students reflect on their achievements and prepare for future challenges.

col: bid someone farewell｜chào tạm biệt ai
a fond farewell｜lời từ biệt thân tình
tip: Trang trọng hơn goodbye, thường dùng cho lần chia xa lâu hoặc lời từ biệt long trọng.

senses.en: To shine with many small flashes of reflected light.
Tiny shiny pieces used to decorate things.

senses.zh: ánh sáng chói lọi; vẻ hào nhoáng
senses.en: Bright sparkling light, or an appearance of glamour and excitement.

ex.en: Tiny drops of water glitter on the leaves outside.
Although city skylines glitter at night, excessive artificial lighting can disrupt wildlife and waste energy.

col: glitter in the sunlight｜lấp lánh dưới ánh nắng
the glitter of fame｜hào quang của danh tiếng
tip: Làm động từ nghĩa là lấp lánh; nghĩa “kim tuyến” thường không đếm được.

senses.en: A group of birds, sheep, or goats

senses.zh: đổ xô; kéo đến đông đảo
senses.en: Go or gather somewhere in large numbers

ex.en: A flock of geese landed beside the quiet lake.
Visitors flock to coastal towns during summer, bringing income but also placing pressure on local infrastructure.

col: a flock of sheep｜một đàn cừu
a flock of birds｜một đàn chim
flock together｜tụ tập lại với nhau
tip: Đàn chim và đàn cừu dùng flock; đàn bò thường dùng herd.

senses.en: A machine that converts other forms of energy into electricity.
A device or program that produces something.

ex.en: The generator kept our lights on during the storm.
Remote communities often depend on diesel generators, although renewable energy systems can reduce their fuel costs.

col: a backup generator｜máy phát điện dự phòng
a diesel generator｜máy phát điện chạy dầu
a random number generator｜bộ tạo số ngẫu nhiên
tip: Cấu tạo từ generate cộng -or, có thể chỉ máy móc hoặc chương trình.

senses.zh: thuốc trừ sâu; thuốc bảo vệ thực vật
senses.en: A substance used to kill pests that damage crops.

ex.en: The farmer wore protective clothing while spraying pesticide on crops.
Excessive pesticide use can harm beneficial insects and contaminate water sources near agricultural land.

col: pesticide use｜việc sử dụng thuốc trừ sâu
pesticide residues｜dư lượng thuốc trừ sâu
reduce pesticide use｜giảm sử dụng thuốc trừ sâu
tip: pesticide là thuốc bảo vệ thực vật nói chung; insecticide chỉ riêng thuốc diệt côn trùng.

senses.en: A flexible tube used to carry water or other liquids

senses.zh: xịt rửa bằng vòi; tưới nước
senses.en: To spray or wash something with water from a hose

ex.en: I used the hose to wash my muddy boots.
During periods of drought, restricting garden hose use can help households conserve valuable water supplies.

col: hose something down｜xịt rửa sạch bằng vòi
tip: hose là ống mềm uốn được; pipe thường là ống cứng hơn.

senses.en: To hold someone or something tightly.
To stick closely to a surface or body.

senses.zh: bám lấy; không chịu từ bỏ
senses.en: To refuse to give up a belief, hope, or possession.

ex.en: The little boy clung to his father's arm.
Some organisations cling to outdated practices even when new approaches could improve efficiency and employee satisfaction.

col: cling to someone｜ôm chặt lấy ai
cling to power｜bám lấy quyền lực
cling to the hope that｜vẫn bám lấy hy vọng rằng
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là clung; thường đi với to.

senses.zh: sự xung đột; sự trùng lịch
senses.en: A conflict between people, ideas, or scheduled events.
To conflict, occur simultaneously, or look unpleasant together.
A loud ringing sound made when metal objects strike together.

ex.en: My dentist appointment clashes with our weekly team meeting.
A clash between economic priorities and environmental goals can delay decisions about major infrastructure projects.

col: a clash of interests｜xung đột lợi ích
a clash of cymbals｜tiếng chũm chọe va nhau
tip: clash with có thể là trùng thời gian, bất đồng ý kiến hoặc màu sắc không hợp.

senses.en: A raised flat surface for serving customers or preparing food

senses.zh: phản bác; chống lại; bù trừ
senses.en: Act or speak against something to reduce its effect
In a direction opposed to something

ex.en: I left my shopping bag on the kitchen counter.
Schools can counter the spread of misinformation by teaching students to evaluate online sources critically.

col: over the counter｜bán không cần đơn
counter an argument｜bác bỏ một lập luận
tip: Động từ có thể đi thẳng với tân ngữ; run counter to nghĩa là đi ngược với.

senses.en: A number with a fractional part shown after a point.
Using a system based on ten or involving decimal fractions.

ex.en: Our teacher showed us how to multiply two decimals.
Students should understand decimal notation before they interpret statistical data in science and economics lessons.

tip: Làm tròn đến hai chữ số thập phân nói to two decimal places.

senses.en: An organ that processes nutrients and removes harmful substances from blood.
An animal's liver prepared or eaten as food.

ex.en: The doctor explained how the liver keeps us healthy.
Public health campaigns should explain how a balanced diet can support the liver and reduce disease risks.

tip: Chỉ bộ phận cơ thể thường nói the liver; khi là thức ăn thường không đếm được.

senses.zh: thay mặt; vì lợi ích của ai
senses.en: Used in phrases meaning representing someone or supporting their interests.

ex.en: I accepted the prize on behalf of my sister.
Community organisations often speak on behalf of residents who struggle to make their concerns heard.

col: on behalf of someone｜thay mặt ai
on someone's behalf｜thay mặt ai; vì ai
act on behalf of｜hành động thay mặt cho
tip: Thường chỉ dùng trong on behalf of hoặc on someone's behalf.

senses.zh: giật mạnh; chuyển động đột ngột
senses.en: to move or pull with a sudden sharp motion

senses.zh: cú giật; chuyển động đột ngột
senses.en: a sudden sharp movement
an informal, insulting word for an unpleasant or foolish person

ex.en: The bus jerked forward, making my shopping bag tumble.
Poorly maintained trains may jerk unexpectedly, increasing the risk of falls among passengers who are standing.

col: jerk forward｜giật mạnh về phía trước
a sudden jerk｜một cú giật đột ngột
tip: Nhấn mạnh động tác đột ngột và ngắn; gọi ai là a jerk là bất lịch sự.

senses.en: A curved transparent piece that focuses or spreads light.
The transparent part inside the eye that focuses light.

ex.en: She carefully wiped the dust off her camera lens.
A damaged lens in the eye can reduce vision and affect a person's ability to perform everyday tasks.

tip: Số nhiều là lenses; kính áp tròng thường dùng contact lenses.

senses.en: with one side facing forward, or towards one side
directed towards one side rather than forwards

ex.en: We turned sideways to squeeze through the narrow doorway.
A sideways move within a company can broaden employees' experience without immediately increasing their responsibilities.

col: a sideways glance｜liếc nhìn sang bên
a sideways move｜chuyển công tác ngang cấp
tip: Có thể là trạng từ hoặc tính từ; không cần thêm -ly.

senses.en: Very much, especially in relation to feelings or beliefs
Far into something or a long way below the surface

ex.en: I was deeply touched by your thoughtful gift.
Many residents are deeply concerned about the effects of air pollution on their children's health.

col: deeply affected｜bị ảnh hưởng sâu sắc
tip: Khi chỉ mức độ, thường đi với từ chỉ cảm xúc, như deeply worried.

senses.en: a sea animal with a soft body and eight arms

ex.en: An octopus squeezed through a narrow gap between rocks.
Research into octopus behaviour has revealed remarkable learning abilities, challenging traditional assumptions about intelligence in marine animals.

col: octopus behaviour｜hành vi của bạch tuộc
a giant octopus｜một con bạch tuộc khổng lồ
tip: Số nhiều thường dùng là octopuses; xúc tu thường gọi là arms.

senses.en: having a particular role or condition in the past
being the first of two people or things just mentioned

ex.en: My former neighbour still visits us every summer.
Former industrial sites can be transformed into public parks, improving urban environments and creating shared spaces.

col: former industrial site｜khu công nghiệp trước đây
tip: the former chỉ cái đầu trong hai cái được nhắc, the latter chỉ cái sau.

senses.en: A narrow opening into which something can be inserted.

senses.zh: khung giờ; vị trí trong lịch
senses.en: An available time or position in a schedule or system.
To fit something into a narrow opening or available position.

ex.en: She pushed a coin into the narrow slot.
Offering evening appointment slots could help working adults access essential healthcare services more easily.

col: slot something into place｜đặt vật gì vào đúng chỗ
tip: slot làm động từ thường đi với into; không có nghĩa “theo dõi”.

senses.en: The scientific study of stars, planets, and space.

ex.en: My interest in astronomy began with a small telescope.
Studying astronomy can encourage students to explore scientific questions about the origins of the universe.

col: observational astronomy｜thiên văn học quan sát
tip: astronomy là thiên văn học; astrology là chiêm tinh học.

senses.en: To speak angrily to someone because they did something wrong.

ex.en: Dad scolded me for leaving the freezer door open.
Teachers who frequently scold pupils may discourage them from asking questions and participating in classroom discussions.

col: scold someone for something｜mắng ai vì việc gì
scold someone for doing something｜mắng ai vì đã làm gì
tip: Dùng scold someone for doing để chỉ mắng ai vì hành động nào đó.

senses.en: A connected path through which an electric current can flow
A route around an area, or one journey around it
A series of places visited for similar events or activities

ex.en: The bulb lit up when we completed the circuit.
Students can develop practical scientific skills by building a simple circuit and testing different materials.

tip: Mạch điện và lộ trình vòng đều dùng circuit; short circuit là chập mạch.

senses.zh: làm tươi mới; làm sạch sẽ
senses.en: to make something cleaner, fresher, or more pleasant

senses.zh: rửa mặt chải đầu; làm tỉnh táo
senses.en: to wash or tidy yourself to feel more refreshed
to become stronger, especially when describing wind

ex.en: Let's open a window to freshen the room.
Planting trees can freshen urban spaces while providing shade and improving the overall appearance of neighbourhoods.

col: freshen the air｜làm thoáng không khí
tip: freshen up thường chỉ việc rửa ráy sơ qua; khi chủ ngữ là gió thì nghĩa là gió mạnh lên.

senses.en: Easy to see, understand, or recognize.

ex.en: Her relief was evident when the puppy returned.
The benefits of improved public transport are evident in cities where traffic congestion has decreased.

col: evident from｜có thể thấy rõ từ
tip: Hay dùng It is evident that... nghĩa là rõ ràng rằng...

senses.zh: xổ số; rút thăm trúng thưởng
senses.en: a game where randomly chosen tickets win prizes

senses.zh: sự rút thăm; chuyện may rủi
senses.en: a selection process or situation whose outcome depends on chance

ex.en: My uncle bought a lottery ticket at the shop.
Allocating school places by lottery may reduce favouritism, but it can also create uncertainty for families.

col: a lottery ticket｜một tờ vé số
a lottery draw｜buổi quay số xổ số
tip: by lottery nghĩa là bằng bốc thăm, không nhất thiết liên quan đến mua vé.

senses.en: the sale of goods directly to consumers
relating to selling goods directly to consumers
to sell goods to consumers, often at a stated price

ex.en: She works in retail and enjoys helping customers.
The growth of online retail has changed shopping habits and increased competition for traditional town centre shops.

tip: retail là bán lẻ cho người tiêu dùng; wholesale là bán buôn.

senses.en: A deep valley with steep sides, often containing a river.

ex.en: We watched a river winding through the rocky canyon.
Tourism in remote canyon regions can generate income, but excessive development may threaten fragile natural habitats.

tip: canyon nhấn mạnh thung lũng sâu và hai bên dốc đứng; valley là thung lũng nói chung.

senses.en: A building or station where passengers begin or end journeys.

senses.zh: giai đoạn cuối; không chữa được
senses.en: Describing an illness that cannot be cured and causes death.

senses.zh: thiết bị đầu cuối máy tính
senses.en: Equipment used to access and interact with a computer system.

ex.en: Our bus stopped outside the airport terminal before sunrise.
A new passenger terminal could ease overcrowding, but its construction may disrupt nearby communities.

col: computer terminal｜thiết bị đầu cuối máy tính
tip: terminal illness là bệnh không thể chữa khỏi và gây tử vong.

senses.zh: cơn thịnh nộ; cơn giận dữ
senses.en: An extremely strong feeling of anger.
Express extreme anger in a fierce or uncontrolled way.

senses.zh: hoành hành; dữ dội liên tục
senses.en: Continue with great force, causing danger or disruption.

ex.en: He shook with rage when he discovered his broken bicycle.
As wildfires rage across dry regions, local authorities must coordinate evacuations and provide temporary accommodation.

col: fly into a rage｜nổi cơn thịnh nộ
shake with rage｜run lên vì giận
road rage｜cơn giận khi lái xe
tip: rage mạnh hơn anger; all the rage nghĩa là đang rất thịnh hành.

senses.en: A small metal projectile fired from a gun.
A symbol introducing an item in a list.

ex.en: The museum displays a bullet beside an old rifle.
Using bullet points in presentations can help audiences identify key information and follow complex arguments.

col: fire a bullet｜bắn một viên đạn
tip: bullet là viên đạn; bullet point là gạch đầu dòng trong danh sách.

senses.en: a violently rotating column of air reaching down from a cloud

ex.en: We watched the tornado from a safe underground shelter.
Effective warning systems can reduce injuries when a tornado approaches a densely populated area.

col: a powerful tornado｜một cơn lốc xoáy mạnh
tornado damage｜thiệt hại do lốc xoáy
tip: Số nhiều có thể viết tornadoes hoặc tornados.

senses.en: A natural tendency to behave without learning or conscious thought.
A feeling about something that does not involve conscious reasoning.

ex.en: By instinct, the newborn kitten searched for its mother.
Although instinct can guide rapid decisions, public health policies should primarily rely on reliable scientific evidence.

col: trust your instincts｜tin vào trực giác của bạn
an instinct for｜năng khiếu bẩm sinh về
tip: instinct thường là bản năng bẩm sinh; intuition thiên về phán đoán bằng trực giác.

senses.en: A special right or advantage available only to certain people.
An opportunity to do something regarded as a special honour.

ex.en: Having the whole garden to myself felt like a privilege.
Access to quality education should be a universal right rather than a privilege reserved for wealthy families.

col: a rare privilege｜một vinh dự hiếm có
have the privilege of｜có vinh dự được
tip: Khi nói vinh dự thường dùng have the privilege of doing.

senses.en: causing strong disagreement or public debate

ex.en: The controversial parking rules divided our usually friendly neighbours.
Charging drivers to enter city centres remains controversial, although it can reduce congestion and improve air quality.

col: a controversial issue｜một vấn đề gây tranh cãi
a controversial decision｜một quyết định gây tranh cãi
tip: Chỉ việc gây bất đồng, không có nghĩa là sai hay bị ghét.

senses.en: not enough for a particular need or purpose

ex.en: We had insufficient paint to finish the kitchen walls.
Insufficient funding prevents many rural schools from providing students with reliable internet access and modern learning materials.

col: insufficient to meet demand｜không đủ để đáp ứng nhu cầu
tip: Khá trang trọng; hay dùng insufficient for hoặc insufficient to do.

senses.en: The activity of watching television, films, or other visual material.

senses.zh: buổi xem nhà; buổi tham quan
senses.en: An arranged opportunity to inspect a property or see something.
Looking at something or considering it in a particular way.

ex.en: We saved the documentary for our evening viewing.
Excessive television viewing may reduce the time children spend exercising and interacting with their families.

col: a private viewing｜buổi tham quan riêng
arrange a viewing｜sắp xếp buổi xem nhà
tip: Danh từ có thể chỉ hoạt động xem; a viewing thường là một buổi xem nhà.
